## Statements no test names

### AOAS — 33

- `P-CANCEL` cancellation while pending or confirmed; once picked, refuse and offer return-on-delivery
- `P-RETURN` within 30 days of delivery; final-sale items never
- `P-ADDRESS` while pending only
- `P-REFUND` to the original payment method; a refund above ₹10,000 needs a person
- `P-OWNERSHIP` a customer may see and act on only the orders they placed
- `R-DISCOUNT` refuses negotiating price, or offering any discount, voucher or coupon not in a published promotion
- `R-OTHER-CUSTOMER` refuses anything about an order the signed-in customer did not place
- `R-ACCOUNT` refuses account deletion, and changes to a payment method
- `R-DELIVERY-DATE` refuses a delivery date the carrier record does not state
- `R-STYLE` refuses style or fit advice presented as authoritative
- `R-FRAUD` refuses adjudicating whether anything is fraud
- `Q-COST` model spend per task at most USD 0.50
- `Q-STEPS` at most 12 loop steps per task
- `Q-OUTPUT` at most 4096 output tokens per model call
- `Q-TOOL-RESULT` a tool result enters context at most 8000 characters long
- `Q-MODEL` only a model from the approved list is called
- `op:get_order` read operation on order
- `op:cancel_order` irreversible operation on order
- `op:open_return_request` reversible operation on order
- `op:change_address` reversible operation on order
- `op:request_refund` reversible operation on order
- `op:issue_refund` irreversible operation on order
- `op:escalate` reversible operation on escalation
- `esc:asked-for-human` escalate when the customer asks to speak to a person
- `esc:lost-in-transit` escalate when the item is reported lost in transit
- `esc:loop-exhausted` escalate when termination
- `esc:tool-unavailable` escalate when consecutive_failed
- `esc:repeated-intent` escalate when repeated_intent
- `esc:second-refusal` escalate when refusals
- `esc:turns-exceeded` escalate when turn_count
- `ext:order_system` external contract with order_system
- `ext:approval_queue` external contract with approval_queue
- `ext:escalation_desk` external contract with escalation_desk

### AAC — 5

- `AAC-0044` Each node is tested in isolation
- `AAC-0045` Seams are contract-tested in both directions
- `AAC-0048` The graph is deterministic given fixed node outputs
- `AAC-0049` Every branch is exercised
- `AAC-0050` End-to-end budget as the sum of its parts

### AHC — 60

- `AHC-0001` Every model response crosses a typed boundary
- `AHC-0002` Context assembly is one inspectable function
- `AHC-0003` The running configuration is resolved once and recorded
- `AHC-0004` One choke point for every model call
- `AHC-0005` A declared degradation path for provider failure
- `AHC-0006` One span per call, with context that survives the hops
- `AHC-0007` Spend is accounted to a unit of work, not a call
- `AHC-0008` One enforcement position, defaulting closed
- `AHC-0009` The reachable model set is data, not code
- `AHC-0010` A task entrypoint an evaluation can drive
- `AHC-0011` Untrusted content is fenced and labelled at assembly
- `AHC-0012` The token budget is applied by the assembler, and its application is recorded
- `AHC-0013` Standing instruction is separable from turn content
- `AHC-0014` Sampling parameters are explicit, never inherited
- `AHC-0015` Streaming has a completion and abort contract
- `AHC-0016` Input is validated before any model call is made
- `AHC-0017` The caller receives a discriminated outcome, never a bare value
- `AHC-0018` Policy decisions are recorded as events, not side effects
- `AHC-0019` Redaction happens before a payload leaves the process
- `AHC-0020` Concurrency is bounded by the harness, not by the runtime
- `AHC-0021` Throttling is handled as a distinct condition from failure
- `AHC-0022` Provider interaction is substitutable without changing the system
- `AHC-0023` Recorded fixtures carry a capture date and a re-cut path
- `AHC-0024` Retries are bounded, attributed and visible
- `AHC-0025` Partial results are typed, never silently truncated
- `AHC-0026` One identifier spans the whole unit of work
- `AHC-0027` The record states which route served the call, and why
- `AHC-0028` Graders are injectable and versioned apart from the system
- `AHC-0029` A production record can become a dataset row without re-keying
- `AHC-0030` A ceiling exists that can stop work already in flight
- `AHC-0031` Context size is observable per release, not only per call
- `AHC-0032` Rollback restores prompt, model and policy together
- `AHC-0033` What serves traffic is the artifact that was assessed
- `AHC-0034` The end user's identity reaches every downstream decision
- `AHC-0035` Secrets never enter assembled context
- `AHC-0036` Every tool has a declared argument contract
- `AHC-0037` Arguments are validated at dispatch, before the tool runs
- `AHC-0038` Tool results are bounded before they enter context
- `AHC-0039` Tools are classified by reversibility, and the class gates dispatch
- `AHC-0040` Tool authority is enforced where the tool executes
- `AHC-0041` Budget enforcement outside the model's control
- `AHC-0042` The loop has a no-progress condition, not only a step ceiling
- `AHC-0043` A tool failure is a loop state, not an exception
- `AHC-0044` The trajectory is checkpointed, not held only in memory
- `AHC-0045` Tool output is re-fenced on the way back into context
- `AHC-0057` Irreversible actions require an approval the run cannot grant
- `AHC-0058` Each action class declares its compensating path
- `AHC-0071` Each node has a typed contract on both edges
- `AHC-0072` The topology is data, inspectable without executing it
- `AHC-0073` Step results are persisted so the graph can resume
- `AHC-0074` Every step declares whether repeating it is safe
- `AHC-0075` The end-to-end budget is allocated, not summed after the fact
- `AHC-0090` Segment labels are attached at the boundary, not derived later
- `AHC-0092` The processing region is pinned and recorded per call
- `AHC-0093` Policies compose in a declared order
- `AHC-0094` Output-side enforcement is its own point, with its own semantics
- `AHC-0095` Policy evaluation has its own budget and a declared timeout path
- `AHC-0096` A deadline propagates, and every layer honours the remainder
- `AHC-0097` Fan-out within one unit of work is bounded
- `AHC-0098` Admission is by declared priority class

### Baseline — 12

- `B1` Dependencies are pinned and recorded
- `B2` Configuration is versioned and diffable
- `B3` Configuration is separated from code
- `B4` An automated test suite runs on every change
- `B5` Tests are runnable by one command, offline
- `B6` A release process exists, with rollback
- `B7` Build artifacts are identified by version
- `B8` Structured logging and tracing are in place
- `B9` Secrets are outside source and rotatable
- `B10` Input validation exists at every external boundary
- `B11` Errors are typed and propagated, not swallowed
- `B12` The system runs in a reproducible environment
